burn_bps.description: Share of the protocol fee that is burned. The rest is sent to `fee_manager`.

create_auction_fee.description: Exact coin charged when creating an auction. Zero amount means no fee.

min_bid_increment_percent.description: Each later bid must be at least this fraction above the previous bid.

trading_fee_percent.description: Fraction of the winning bid paid as the protocol fee (for example 0.02 = 2%).

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_decimal_Decimal
definitions.description:
A fixed-point decimal value with 18 fractional digits, i.e. Decimal(1_000_000_000_000_000_000) == 1.0

The greatest possible value that can be represented is 340282366920938463463.374607431768211455 = (2^128 - 1) / 10^18
